span: Grant of enhanced compensation as granted in the case of other land owners, under the same acquisition, who appealed against the impugned judgment expeditiously – If permissible
why: Headnote frames whether enhanced compensation may be extended to a late appellant; the Held portion is in the next passage.

span: the original landowners – claimants – appellants herein are entitled to the compensation @ Rs.28.12 paisa per square yard with respect to the lands acquired in the year 1976
why: Court's operative order: compensation is enhanced and the High Court's judgment modified accordingly.

span: Interest u/s. 34 can start only from the date the possession of the acquired land is taken
why: Headnote on the starting date of interest under s.34, not on enhancing the compensation amount.

span: Compensation determined on the basis of the Notification 5 years later, cannot be a yardstick for determining the compensation for the land which is acquired five years before
why: Headnote holding: the High Court's enhancement based on later acquisitions is wrong; the claimants are not entitled to the same higher compensation.

span: High Court erred in enhancing the amount of compensation by 800% from Rs. 21/- per sq.
why: Headnote holding: the High Court's enhancement based on Ready Reckoner rates is quashed.

span: The marginal reduction of rates in two types of land cannot be faulted with.
why: Headnote: the High Court's enhancement for one land type and reduction for two others is upheld; the court both accepts an enhancement and refuses to restore the higher rates.
